subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is celebrated in the Hindu month of Phalgun?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Holi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Holi is a popular ancient Indian festival, also known as the "Festival of Love", the "Festival of Colours" and the "Festival of Spring". The festival celebrates the eternal and divine love of Radha Krishna.
 
• It is celebrated every year on the day after the full moon in the Hindu month of **Phalgun **which is early March.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• 
 Holi Celebrations in the different states of India

 
 
 
• Rang Panchami – Maharashtra.

 
 
• In Maharashtra, Holi is also known as Shigma or Rang Panchami (colour on the fifth)
 
 
 
• Holla Mohalla- Punjab
 
• Shigmo- Goa
 
• Royal Holi- Udaipur
 
• Kumaoni Holi - Uttarakhand
 
• Manjal Kuli- Kerala
